title: Loony Lynx Style [LORA/Krea 2]
description:
This was an experiment to see how much I could get into a LoRA with a very limited dataset.

Loony Lynx is an artist who has not posted art online since 1999. I only had half a dozen images to work with. I experimented with enhancing the few images I had with seedance upscaling, and style extraction using the Noob Style IPAdapter to generate more images in the target style. I think this turned out really well starting with only a half a dozen low quality GIF images sized 480x480 and smaller.

loonylynx is the trigger for the Noob version, @loonylynx is the trigger for the Anima and Krea2 versions.
